Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the pilot went well from Product's side and Compliance asked us to get ahead of contract items before we turn on production traffic. I attached our annotated DPA (eurodatapay_dpa_redlines.pdf) with three areas we need clarity on:

- International transfer mechanism: we see SCCs + an additional customer addendum in the draft, but our legal team is questioning whether a Transfer Impact Addendum is sufficient for some regulated data categories.
- Roles & delegation: we flagged some processor/processor-of-processor language where we need to confirm who signs off on subprocessor additions and how responsibilities are allocated (order form vs DPA).
- Export controls / data residency: a short clause around export controls/escrow choices.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will take the lead on the redlines and a rough timeline? Ideally we get a revised DPA + tracked redlines back within one week so our counsel can review.

Appreciate it — Luca

Hannah / Laura — quick pass from legal attached (k_i_redlines.txt). Top-line notes:

1) Transfer mechanism:
- For regulated categories, SCCs + a short Transfer Impact Attachment (TIA) should be fine provided EuroDataPay can accept the standard limitations on onward transfers and Redwood documents compensating measures (encryption at rest, restricted admin ops).

2) Roles & delegation: proposed language to tighten approval flow for subprocessors (Order Form to list initial subprocessors; DPA to contain sign-off process for additions and a 30-day objection window).

3) Export controls: recommend a narrowly scoped clause referencing applicable jurisdictions and a commitment to notify within 5 business days of any export-control triggered access.

4) Evidence and timelines: Compliance will need the subprocessor list + SOC2 summary and a portable evidence packet for your legal (we can provide a redacted SOC2 and network architecture snapshot).

I’ve phrased redlines to keep commercial flexibility; Laura please coordinate order-form numbers and the DocuSign flow.

Attachment: k_i_redlines.txt (plain-text redline suggestions)

-Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
